lines.zh: 四条短腿捣得快，步子却很小。
lines.en: Four short legs pump fast but cover very little ground.

lines.zh: 我贴着水底走，泥从趾缝冒出来。
lines.en: I walk along the bottom, mud rising between my toes.

lines.zh: 岸线上一步是水，一步是沙。
lines.en: On this shore one step is water, the next is sand.

lines.zh: 每走三步，我就要停下来换气。
lines.en: Every three steps I stop to take a breath.

lines.zh: 湿泥在我身下吱吱作响。
lines.en: Wet mud squeaks underneath my belly.

lines.zh: 我沿岸边绕，不进深水也不上干地。
lines.en: I skirt the shore, never deep water, never dry ground.

lines.zh: 我的肚皮擦着沙，留下一道浅沟。
lines.en: My belly drags the sand and leaves a shallow groove.

lines.zh: 四只脚一起滑，我就整只滑进池塘。
lines.en: All four feet slip, and I slide into the pond whole.

lines.zh: 潮水退了，我跟着往水里退。
lines.en: The tide pulled back, and I follow it down.

lines.zh: 短腿不是缺点，浅水就吃这一套。
lines.en: Short legs are no flaw; shallow water rewards them.

lines.zh: 我从芦苇根下钻过去，很轻松。
lines.en: I slip under the reed roots without any trouble.

lines.zh: 走路时我一半身子还在水里。
lines.en: As I walk, half of me stays in the water.

lines.zh: 水边的碎石硌着我的腹甲。
lines.en: The gravel at the waterline grates against my belly plate.

lines.zh: 我一步一步量这条河的宽度。
lines.en: Step by step, I measure how wide this river runs.

lines.zh: 我四条腿一蹬，滑过一小段浅滩。
lines.en: All four legs push and I slide over a stretch of shallows.

lines.zh: 我爬到一块石头上，只待一息。
lines.en: I haul onto a stone and rest for one breath.

lines.zh: 水没过我的背，我懒得动。
lines.en: Water covers my back and I cannot be bothered to move.

lines.zh: 我把四只脚收在身下晒。
lines.en: I tuck all four feet beneath me to dry.

lines.zh: 肺在壳里鼓了一下，又瘪了。
lines.en: The lung inside my shell swells once, then slackens.

lines.zh: 水边的空气有种烂叶的味道。
lines.en: The air by the water smells of rotting leaves.

lines.zh: 我半沉在水里，像一截湿木头。
lines.en: I float half-sunk, like a waterlogged piece of wood.

lines.zh: 进化给了我四条腿，没给耐心。
lines.en: Evolution gave me four legs and no patience at all.

lines.zh: 我在等一只鳕鱼游得太近。
lines.en: I am waiting for a cod to swim too close.

lines.zh: 水底的泥是暖的，我趴在上面。
lines.en: The bottom mud is warm, and I lie on it.

lines.zh: 岸上太干，我待不了太久。
lines.en: The bank is too dry for me to stay long.

lines.zh: 我用前脚抹了抹嘴边的水。
lines.en: I wipe the water from my mouth with a front foot.

lines.zh: 安静的时候，我能听见水草长。
lines.en: In the quiet I can hear the waterweed growing.

lines.zh: 这个池塘比我上次来的小。
lines.en: This pond is smaller than the one I remember.

lines.zh: 我把墨囊里的东西晃了晃。
lines.en: I slosh what is left inside my ink sac.

lines.zh: 我不知道自己进化得对不对。
lines.en: I am not sure my evolution came out right.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来，我才看清你的鞋。
lines.en: You crouch down, and only then do I see your shoes.

lines.zh: 四只眼睛看你，还是只看见一个。
lines.en: Four eyes look at you and still see only one person.

lines.zh: 你的影子落到水里，吓跑了鱼。
lines.en: Your shadow falls on the water and scares off the fish.

lines.zh: 你身上的味道，像我吃过的墨。
lines.en: You smell like the ink I have eaten before.

lines.zh: 别把手伸进水里，我不认得手指。
lines.en: Do not put your hand in the water; I do not know fingers.

lines.zh: 你站得太直了，水里没人这样。
lines.en: You stand too straight; nobody in the water does that.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，水就从嘴角流下。
lines.en: I look up at you and water runs from my jaw.

lines.zh: 你的倒影比我大，但不会动。
lines.en: Your reflection is bigger than me and does not move.

lines.zh: 我们的距离，正好是一次扑击。
lines.en: The distance between us is exactly one lunge.

lines.zh: 我在你脚边转了一圈，测水深。
lines.en: I circle your feet once, measuring the depth.

lines.zh: 我的皮被划开，水立刻灌进来。
lines.en: My hide split open, and water rushed in at once.

lines.zh: 这一下打偏了，我还能游。
lines.en: That blow went wide, and I can still swim.

lines.zh: 我缩起四条腿，护住肚子。
lines.en: I pull my four legs in to guard my belly.

lines.zh: 你打到的是泥，不是我。
lines.en: You hit the mud, not me.

lines.zh: 疼得我往水里退了一截。
lines.en: It hurts enough to push me back into the water.

lines.zh: 我的肺在壳里撞了一下。
lines.en: My lung knocks once against the inside of its shell.

lines.zh: 这层皮很薄，可它挡过很多次。
lines.en: This hide is thin, but it has turned many blows.

lines.zh: 你再来一下，我就翻过来了。
lines.en: One more of those and I will be on my back.

lines.zh: 伤口在水里不流血。
lines.en: Wounds do not bleed much underwater.

lines.zh: 我咬住自己的牙，没叫出声。
lines.en: I bite down on my own teeth and make no sound.

lines.zh: 生鳕鱼的味道，从你口袋出来。
lines.en: The smell of raw cod is coming from your pocket.

lines.zh: 你拿鱼晃，我的四只脚就跟着晃。
lines.en: You wave the fish, and all four of my feet wave too.

lines.zh: 墨囊我吃过，腥得很对。
lines.en: I have eaten ink sacs; that fishy taste is correct.

lines.zh: 把鱼扔远点，我怕咬到你的手。
lines.en: Throw the fish further; I would rather not bite your hand.

lines.zh: 我不追人，我追那股腥味。
lines.en: I do not chase people; I chase that fishy smell.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西在滴水，是活的吧。
lines.en: What you hold is dripping; is it still alive?

lines.zh: 再靠近一米，我就不客气了。
lines.en: Come one meter closer and I stop being polite.

lines.zh: 这条鱼够我撑两天。
lines.en: One fish like that will last me two days.

lines.zh: 我闻到水草下面的鳕鱼群。
lines.en: I smell a school of cod beneath the waterweed.

lines.zh: 食物在岸上，我就冒险上一次岸。
lines.en: If the food is on land, I risk the land once.

lines.zh: 你踢到我，我身上的水全甩给你。
lines.en: You kick me, and all my water flies onto you.

lines.zh: 四条腿站不稳，被撞就翻。
lines.en: Four legs stand badly; one shove and I tip over.

lines.zh: 我在你腿边蹭过去，留下一片湿。
lines.en: I brush past your legs and leave a wet patch.

lines.zh: 水边的路窄，我们总得碰一下。
lines.en: The path by the water is narrow; we must touch.

lines.zh: 别踩我的背，那里是肺。
lines.en: Do not step on my back; the lung sits there.

lines.zh: 我这身皮滑，你扶不住。
lines.en: This hide is slick, and you cannot hold it.

lines.zh: 碰撞之后，我先滑进水里。
lines.en: After we collide, I slide into the water first.

lines.zh: 你把我推得横过来，我讨厌这样。
lines.en: You shoved me sideways, and I hate being sideways.

lines.zh: 我们撞出的水声，引来了别的鱼。
lines.en: The splash we made drew other fish to us.

lines.zh: 我贴着你站，是在试你的重量。
lines.en: Standing against you, I am testing your weight.

lines.zh: 我们四条腿缠在一起，很难分开。
lines.en: Our four legs tangle together and are hard to part.

lines.zh: 她在水里等我，背上有一道旧伤。
lines.en: She waits in the water with an old scar on her back.

lines.zh: 交配之后，我把卵埋进泥里。
lines.en: Afterward I bury the eggs deep in the mud.

lines.zh: 我们轮流守着那一片浅滩。
lines.en: We take turns guarding that stretch of shallows.

lines.zh: 她的叫声低，我的高，正好配。
lines.en: Her call is low, mine is high, and they fit.

lines.zh: 她产卵时我守在旁边，寸步不离。
lines.en: While she lays, I stay beside her and never leave.

lines.zh: 我的肺在求偶时鼓得最大。
lines.en: My lung swells largest when I am courting.

lines.zh: 这片水域只养得起一窝幼体。
lines.en: This water can only feed one clutch of young.

lines.zh: 她要是走了，我就守着泥。
lines.en: If she leaves, I stay and guard the mud.

lines.zh: 幼体孵出来，先吃水草再吃肉。
lines.en: The young hatch and eat weed before they eat meat.

lines.zh: 我捡了块扁石，垫在身下。
lines.en: I pick up a flat stone and tuck it under myself.

lines.zh: 水里落下的东西，我都会翻一遍。
lines.en: Whatever falls into the water, I turn over once.

lines.zh: 这枚鳞片归我，谁也别抢。
lines.en: This scale is mine, and nobody should try.

lines.zh: 我把吃剩的鳕鱼骨叼到岸上。
lines.en: I carry the cod bones I stripped up onto the bank.

lines.zh: 墨囊破了，弄得我满嘴黑。
lines.en: The ink sac burst and left my mouth black.

lines.zh: 这块东西沉，我用四只脚抱住。
lines.en: This thing is heavy, so I hug it with four feet.

lines.zh: 我用嘴叼起它，四只脚只顾站着。
lines.en: I lift it with my mouth; my four feet only stand.

lines.zh: 水底的铜片反光，我喜欢。
lines.en: The copper piece on the bottom glints, and I like it.

lines.zh: 有人丢下的鱼，我不问来路。
lines.en: Fish someone dropped; I do not ask where from.

lines.zh: 我攒了一堆小石头，没什么用。
lines.en: I have collected a pile of pebbles with no use.

lines.zh: 水动了一下，我四条腿都停住。
lines.en: The water moved once, and all four of my legs stopped.

lines.zh: 岸上有脚步，节奏不像鱼。
lines.en: There are footsteps on the bank, and they are no fish.

lines.zh: 水浑了，说明有大的东西下来。
lines.en: The water clouded, which means something large came down.

lines.zh: 你的影子先动，我才看见人。
lines.en: Your shadow shifted first, and then I saw the man.

lines.zh: 血腥味从浅滩那头飘过来。
lines.en: The smell of blood drifts over from the shallows.

lines.zh: 你踩破了水面的膜，我听见了。
lines.en: You broke the surface film, and I heard it.

lines.zh: 在我这里，会走路的都算猎物。
lines.en: Around here, anything that walks counts as prey.

lines.zh: 我把头转向声音，脚已经动了。
lines.en: I turn my head toward the sound; my feet already moved.

lines.zh: 这条岸线只有你一个活物。
lines.en: You are the only living thing on this shoreline.

lines.zh: 我不急着咬，先看你会不会掉进来。
lines.en: I do not rush; first I watch whether you fall in.

lines.zh: 你沿着岸跑，我沿着水跟。
lines.en: You run along the bank; I follow along the water.

lines.zh: 我算好了，你会在那块石头前减速。
lines.en: I have it figured: you will slow at that rock.

lines.zh: 浅水让我快，深水让我更快。
lines.en: Shallow water speeds me, and deep water speeds me more.

lines.zh: 你喘得厉害，我等得起。
lines.en: You are breathing hard, and I can afford to wait.

lines.zh: 我不堵大路，我堵你下水的口。
lines.en: I do not block the road, only your way into the water.

lines.zh: 你每退一步，身后的芦苇就响一声。
lines.en: Every step you retreat, the reeds behind you rustle.

lines.zh: 我的腿短，所以我的路线直。
lines.en: My legs are short, so my line stays straight.

lines.zh: 你在岸上犹豫，我已经决定了。
lines.en: You hesitate on the bank; I have already decided.

lines.zh: 往左边是泥，往右边还是我。
lines.en: Left is mud, and right is still me.

lines.zh: 等你蹲下捡东西的那一刻，正好。
lines.en: The moment you crouch to pick something up, perfect.

lines.zh: 我咬住你的脚踝，水帮我按着你。
lines.en: I bite your ankle, and the water holds you for me.

lines.zh: 四只脚撑地，整只身体弹出去。
lines.en: Four feet brace against the bottom and my body springs.

lines.zh: 这一口不深，但会留疤。
lines.en: This bite is not deep, but it leaves a scar.

lines.zh: 我撞你的膝弯，你一定会跪。
lines.en: I hit the back of your knee and you will kneel.

lines.zh: 水花挡住我的头，牙先到。
lines.en: The splash hides my head, and my teeth arrive first.

lines.zh: 咬完我就退回水里，你追不上。
lines.en: I bite, then back into the water where you cannot follow.

lines.zh: 我的嘴不大，咬合力不小。
lines.en: My mouth is small, but its grip is not.

lines.zh: 你护着腿，那我就咬手。
lines.en: You guard your legs, so I go for your hands.

lines.zh: 十点力气，落在同一条筋上。
lines.en: One effort, all of it on the same tendon.

lines.zh: 湿泥让我慢半拍，可你还在地上。
lines.en: Wet mud slows me a half beat, but you are still down.

lines.zh: 我从池塘底下的泥里钻出来。
lines.en: I climb out of the mud at the bottom of the pond.

lines.zh: 水草给了我藏身的地方。
lines.en: The waterweed gave me somewhere to hide.

lines.zh: 浅滩上多了一只四短足的东西。
lines.en: The shallows gained one more four-legged thing.

lines.zh: 我第一次呼吸，肺先响了。
lines.en: On my first breath, the lung made the sound.

lines.zh: 这条河比我出生的那条宽。
lines.en: This river is wider than the one I was born in.

lines.zh: 我爬上泥岸，身上的水一直在滴。
lines.en: I climb the muddy bank, water still dripping off me.

lines.zh: 淤泥里暖和，刚孵出的我不动。
lines.en: The silt is warm, and the newly hatched me stays still.

lines.zh: 我学着用四条腿站住。
lines.en: I am learning to stand on four legs.

lines.zh: 暴风的水顺河下来，把我推到岸。
lines.en: Storm water came down the river and pushed me ashore.

lines.zh: 这里有很多鱼，我打算留下。
lines.en: There are plenty of fish here; I intend to stay.

lines.zh: 火烤到我的皮，水汽冒了一地。
lines.en: Fire on my hide sends steam rolling across the ground.

lines.zh: 从岸上摔下来，四只脚都没抓住。
lines.en: I fell from the bank and all four feet missed.

lines.zh: 我吸进了水，肺在壳里乱撞。
lines.en: I breathed water in, and my lung pounds inside its shell.

lines.zh: 气浪把我掀进水里，正好。
lines.en: The blast throws me into the water, which suits me.

lines.zh: 箭扎进背甲，离肺只差一点。
lines.en: The arrow sticks in my back plate, a little from the lung.

lines.zh: 药水味钻进鳃，我整只都软了。
lines.en: Potion vapor seeps into my gills and I go slack.

lines.zh: 河里没鱼了，我的肺也饿。
lines.en: The river has no fish left, and my lung is hungry too.

lines.zh: 雷顺着湿泥传过来，麻到脚趾。
lines.en: Lightning runs through the wet mud down to my toes.

lines.zh: 水里空了，连泥都被抽走。
lines.en: The water emptied, and even the mud was pulled away.
